ctx.x: … and they interviewed the a few survivors: Joe Wilder, and John Bunch was still alive, and Jerry Dodgion and Johnny Frosk and myself were interviewed for the uh, for the uh final film. So it I can’t wait to see it.
Well, fast forward back to the ‘70s. We talked yesterday about all the stuff that you did, you know, pop stuff, and other things. But you started your own group in early seventies …
